caption: A bathroom window is fogged after a shower, and where a hairdryer blows on the glass the view of the yard outside sharpens.

sa.check: A bathroom window is fogged after a shower.
A hairdryer blows on the glass.
The view of the yard outside sharpens where the air blows.
The view stays clear while the glass is dry.

pc.expect: The view goes from blurred to clear where the warm air dries the glass and does not blur again while dry.
pc.fail: It blurs again under the dryer; or it clears where no air blows; or it flickers.

pc.expect: The yard outside is unchanged; only the fog changes.
pc.fail: The yard changes; or a different scene appears; or the glass warps.

pc.expect: The clear patch is where the dryer is aimed.
pc.fail: It is elsewhere; or the whole pane clears at once from one spot; or the patch appears before the dryer.

pc.expect: The fog is a film of moisture that evaporates.
pc.fail: It peels; or is a solid coating; or drips as ice.
The window duplicates; or the dryer vanishes; or the dryer passes through the glass.

pc.expect: The frame and the bathroom stay the same.
pc.fail: The frame changes; or the room rearranges; or the dryer changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
